titulek: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people
titulekPuvodni: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people
shrnuti: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.

vyrez.text:
Ukraine war: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people - BBC News
Image source, Reuters
By Vitaly Shevchenko   and   Tom McArthur
Published
10 October 2026, 11:29 BST
Updated 1 hour ago
Russia has attacked the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia with five glide bombs, killing at least 15 people including three children, officials said.
The glide bombs hit residential buildings in the south-eastern city on Saturday morning. At least 16 others were injured in the attack, with more still missing and believed to be under the rubble.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the attacks on Zaporizhzhia were Russia expressing "its thanks" for a deal announced by US President Donald Trump last night easing sanctions on Moscow to import Russian diesel.
He added that 13 other regions had come under attack overnight, arguing this demonstrated Russia took "any easing of pressure to mean they can keep fighting".
Photos and videos from the site of one of the strikes in Zaporizhzhia show an apartment block mostly destroyed.
"The ground floor was hit, and the floors above just collapsed," acting Mayor Regina Kharchenko told Ukrainian television from the scene.

Raketové a dronové údery zasiahli Kyjev, Dnipro, Kremenčuk aj ďalšie mestá a pripravili o život najmenej jedenásť ľudí. Pred zimou sa stupňuje ruské bombardovanie.
Ruská raketa v stredu zasiahla výškovú obytnú budovu na severe Ukrajiny a zabila päť ľudí, oznámil ukrajinský prezident Volodymyr Zelenskyj. Germany arrests former domestic intelligence chief over alleged spying
August Hanning served as president of Federal Intelligence Service from 1998 to 2005
Germany’s federal prosecutor’s office has said a former domestic intelligence chief was arrested on Tuesday on espionage allegations.
August Hanning served as president of the Federal Intelligence Service (BND) from December 1998 to November 2005.
Hanning was arrested in Bad Toelz-Wolfratshausen, in southern Germany. A former aide of his, identified only as Manfred D, was also arrested on Tuesday.
The prosecutor’s office did not reveal who the men were suspected of spying for.

A post about the unveiling of a memorial to the dead pilots later appeared on the “Rural News” community page for Seryshevo, a village in the Amur region where the Ukrainka air base is located. A bomb destroyed a car belonging to a participant in Russia’s war against Ukraine on October 2 in Novomoskovsk, in Russia’s Tula region, the Ukrainian monitoring Telegram channel Exilenova+ reported.
The bomb had been planted under the car’s chassis, according to  data from the anonymous Russian Telegram channel VChK-OGPU. The driver killed was identified as Roman Syromyatnikov, and the Novomoskovsk-based news outlet Novomoskovsk Segodnya confirmed the death of a person by that name.
Syromyatnikov worked at Russia’s Federal Penitentiary Service (FSIN) facilities in the Tula region during the 2010s. He signed a contract with Russia’s Defense Ministry in 2023 and returned to the Tula region for medical treatment in late 2024, the independent Russian investigative outlet iStories reported , citing leaked data.

Ukrajinský prezident Volodymyr Zelenskyj počátkem týdne řekl, že Rusko už prakticky zahájilo mobilizaci, když různými způsoby zvyšuje počet lidí, které nabírá.

Poland says Russian military helicopter violated its airspace
September 23, 2026, 3:04 pm
Source: Operational Command of the Polish Armed Forces
A Russian military Mi-8 helicopter entered Polish airspace on September 23 at 11:08 a.m., the operational command of the Polish army said.
The helicopter, flying from the Kaliningrad region, crossed about 300 meters (984 feet) into Polish airspace and remained there for 42 seconds, the Polish military said.
Poland scrambled fighter jets and put ground forces and equipment on alert. “The nature of the incident indicates that Russia is once again testing the readiness of our air defense,” the command said.
Russia has not yet commented on the incident.
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said on September 17 that Russia is planning “hybrid” strikes using missiles and drones against countries that support Ukraine. He claimed that “there is a real risk that drones or other types of missiles may fly into the territory of one or more NATO countries on the eastern flank, even cause destruction.”

Several aircraft from Russia’s Rossiya Special Flight Detachment, which transports the country’s leaders and senior officials, circled over Moscow on the evening of October 9 because of the threat of a Ukrainian drone attack.
Five of the detachment’s aircraft were unable to land immediately. At least three were returning from Turkmenistan, where Russian President Vladimir Putin had attended a Commonwealth of Independent States summit, several Russian news outlets and Telegram channels reported ( 1 , 2 , 3 ). All three were Il-96s, the type used to transport the president, Agentstvo reported .

V Černé Hoře zadrželi zakladatele telegramového kanálu Rybar Michaila Zvinčuka. Spolu s manželkou a spolupracovníky má být vyhoštěn ze země.
Jaké jsou klíčové směry na frontě podle Rybara, ukrajinských a nezávislých analytiků.
Zapomeňte na Slovjansk , jeho dobytí je aktuálně nereálné.
Ukrajinský tlak ve směru na Velyku Novosilku pokračuje, bojuje se už u Komaru na východním břehu říčky Mokri Jaly.
Rusové pronikají do Dobropillji, na jejich křídlo však ze severu tlačí ukrajinský protiútok.
Už i bitva o datová centra je obousměrná, Ukrajinci útočí na „ruský Google“.
Mapy dne: slovjanský směr; velykonovosilský směr; dobropilljský směr.
Videa dne: scéna jako z druhé světové války – MiG-29 sestřeluje dron kanonem; vojáci čistí síť ruských bunkrů; raketomet HIMARS zničil dělostřelecký radar; jak to vypadá na silnici R-280 na Krym.

On September 20, 2026, Ukraine launched another large-scale drone attack on the Moscow region. One drone hit a high-rise apartment building in Kotelniki, southeast of Moscow. A powerful explosion shook Colonita, a small village in the municipality of Chișinău , at 4.20 a.m. on September 18. Residents saw a blinding flash and heard a terrifying blast that made houses tremble. Six hours later, emergency teams found the remains of a Russian drone — including its engine — scattered across agricultural land. The device had fallen about four miles from the center of the Moldovan capital, which is home to more than 700,000 people. It had not been detected by surveillance systems, which the Defense Ministry attributed to the speed and low altitude at which it was flying.

V bavorské obci Berngau zastřelil muž při kontrole zbraní dva úředníky. Policie dům obklíčila, na místě zasahovalo zhruba 150 policistů s obrněným vozem i vrtulníky. Muže následně zadržela.
Článek
Německá policie v noci na pátek zadržela muže, který ve čtvrtek v bavorské obci Berngau zastřelil dva úředníky při kontrole zbraní. Šedesátiletý podezřelý byl při zásahu postřelen do nohy. Podle agentury DPA to uvedla mluvčí policejního ředitelství. K motivu činu zatím policie žádné informace nesdělila.
Oběťmi jsou 54letá pracovnice a 45letý pracovník zemského okresu Neumarkt v Horní Falci. Měli mimo jiné zkontrolovat, zda muž své zbraně řádně uchovává. První zprávy hovořily o jednom mrtvém a jedné těžce zraněné ženě; ta však svým zraněním později podlehla.
První tísňová volání přišla kolem 14:00, místní obyvatelé policii nahlásili střelbu.…

Deel dit artikel
Defensieminister Yesilgöz (VVD) spreekt niet langer over Rusland als "de agressor" maar als "de vijand". Met een toenemend aantal sabotagepraktijken, drone-aanvallen en andere soorten dreigingen en incidenten op ons continent vindt de minister dat je duidelijk moet benoemen wat er aan de hand is.
Lang werd er niet in zulke bewoordingen over Rusland gesproken dus haar woorden -tijdens de behandeling van de defensiebegroting in de Tweede Kamer- baarden vandaag in Den Haag opzien.
Toch betekent het voor het daadwerkelijke beleid niets, lichtte Yesilgöz in een schorsing van het debat tegen de NOS toe. Dat beleid om meer te investeren in onze veiligheid, alert te zijn en samen met Europese landen op te trekken is al jaren - sinds de invasie in Oekraïne - aan de gang. "Het is heel duidelijk dat Rusland zich als de vijand presenteert. Dat wil nog niet zeggen dat wij in oorlog zijn of ineens een heel andere aanpak gaan hebben."

The FSB's sabotage campaign in Europe: Russia's war on Western arms makers – and what it means for Ukraine | Ukrainska Pravda
A disaster was narrowly averted in Germany in summer 2026. On the night of 4-5 August, unidentified individuals attempted to attack Leipzig airport with three explosive-laden FPV drones. Their target was a Ukrainian Ruslan aircraft operated by Antonov Airlines. The Ruslans are an important link in the military logistics chain, transporting cargo not only for Ukraine but also for NATO countries more broadly.
A source familiar with the incident told Ukrainska Pravda that the Ukrainians had three strokes of luck that night. The explosive on the first drone failed to detonate, the second drone crashed into another aircraft, and the third never made it into the air. Police found it only a few weeks later on the outskirts of the airport. Something had apparently spooked the perpetrator.
According to Politico, investigators soon noticed similarities between the drone's warhead and other improvised explosive devices found in caches set up by Russian agents elsewhere in Europe.

Russia’s strike on Ukraine’s Kramatorsk killed 33 people aboard two passenger buses. Photos from the aftermath.
October 8, 2026, 12:46 pm
Source: Meduza
On October 8, Russia attacked Kramatorsk, a frontline city in Ukraine’s Donetsk region. The strike was likely carried out using a guided bomb. It  hit two commuter buses carrying passengers. According to the latest figures, 33 people have died and 18 have been injured. The entire road was strewn with bodies. After the attack, authorities halted public transportation in Kramatorsk and the neighboring city of Sloviansk. These are the two largest cities in Donbas that remain under Ukrainian control.
Meduza is publishing photographs of the aftermath of the strike on Kramatorsk. We warn readers that some of the images are extremely difficult to look at.

Nejméně 30 mrtvých. Z autobusů v Kramatorsku zbyly po zásahu ruskou bombou ohořelé dráty a těla na ulici — Deník N
Trosky jednoho ze dvou zničených autobusů v Kramatorsku. Ruský letecký úder zabil nejméně 30 lidí. Foto: DSNS Donecké oblasti
Ruské letectvo ve východoukrajinském Kramatorsku udeřilo leteckou bombou na linkové autobusy. Jeden z nejkrvavějších útoků roku zabil nejméně 30 lidí, 18 je zraněných. Rusové úder provedli den po podobně smrtícím útoku v Prylukách.
Více o poslechu Deníku N
Kramatorsk je donbaské město, jedno z mála center regionu, které ruské síly dosud nedobyly. Je tak blízko frontě, že ho Rusové mohou zasáhnout klouzavými leteckými bombami – zbraní, kterou letadlo vypustí na své straně hranice, ona pak doplachtí, kam jí to vyjde, a tam zabíjí.
Přesně to se stalo v Kramatorsku. Kyiv Post píše, že ruská bomba zasáhla dva linkové autobusy. Podle vyšetřovatelů šlo zřejmě o bombu typu D-30SN. Ten se používá až na stokilometrovou vzdálenost. Nese stokilovou bojovou hlavici.
Proti autobusu to je naprosto ničivá zbraň.
Hlava regionální civilní a vojenské správy Vadym Filaškin oznámil, že na místě útoku je 30 mrtvých a 18 zraněných. Tento počet ale nemusí být…

One person killed in second school knife attack in Poland in two days
Oct 8, 2026 | Law , Society
Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work!
Notes from Poland is run by a small editorial team and is published by an independent, non-profit foundation that is funded through donations from our readers. We cannot do what we do without your support.
One person has been killed in a knife attack on a primary school carried out today by a 15-year-old former pupil. It comes just a day after another knife attack by a 19-year-old on a different school in Poland, which left eight people injured. The assailant was also carrying a homemade explosive device that failed to detonate.
Meanwhile, police also announced today the arrest of a 17-year-old who had reportedly threatened to attack a school and was found to be in possession of knives.
The developments have caused shock in Poland, a country where such violent incidents are normally rare. “We are seeing a radicalisation of young people,” warns the education minister, who has called for tougher controls on…

Unverified images Drone hits Yandex data centre, in first such attack on Russia
AFP
Published: 08.10.26 11:03 , Update: 08.10.26 11:52
Yandex is Russia's largest technology company
© AFP/File
A drone caused a fire at a data centre belonging to Russian technology company Yandex, the company told AFP Thursday, in the first such strike of its kind on Russia.
Unverified images published on social media showed columns of thick, black smoke pouring from the roof of the building, which the company said was in the central Ryazan region, located southeast of Moscow.
Both Russia and Ukraine have intensified long-range strikes on each other in recent months, with recent Russian attacks targeting Ukrainian data centres and logistics warehouses.
The former head of Ukraine's Center for Countering Disinformation said Kyiv was responsible for the strike, writing on Telegram: "Two can play at this game".
Yandex is Russia's largest technology company.

by Jonas Heins
A bus is burning as the consequence of a deadly Russian strike on Kramatorsk on oct. 8, 2026. (Via Telegram/ Vadym Filashkin)
A Russian glide bomb strike on a bus stop in Kramatorsk killed 30 people on the morning of Oct. 8, Donetsk regional governor Vadym Filashkin said.
Eighteen more people were injured in the Russian attack, Filashkin said . In photos of the strike that he shared on Telegram, at least one burned-out bus can be seen on a road.
"Russia comes to the Ukrainian land with death. She hits our cities, kills our people and multiplies her crimes every day," Filashkin said .
The Kramatorsk and Sloviansk military administrations ordered the stop of all public transport.
"The Russians are targeting civilians. For them, a bus with passengers is an attractive target precisely because one hit can kill as many people as possible," Filashkin said.

Článek
„Komisař ze semilského oddělení obecné kriminality celý spisový materiál s návrhem na podání obžaloby obviněného 38letého muže, který je stíhán vazebně, předal Okresnímu státnímu zastupitelství v Semilech,“ informovala policejní mluvčí Dagmar Sochorová.
Muž má podle policie na svědomí dvě přepadení poštovních poboček. Poprvé se vydal pro lup do Košťálova, kde překvapil pracovnice 23. června. Vtrhl tam ozbrojený střelnou zbraní a žádal vydání hotovosti. S penězi pak vyběhl z poštovní budovy, sedl na motorku a ujel.
Podruhé, podle téměř totožného scénáře, přepadl i pobočku pošty…

Článek
Ministr obrany Roberts Kaunas prohlásil, že rozhodnutí vyslat vojáky na pomoc při posílení bezpečnosti litevské hranice s ruskou Kaliningradskou oblastí bude provedeno neprodleně. Doplnil, že do 16. října nasadí na hranice až sto vojáků, uvedla LRT .
Podle ministra vnitra Martynase Katelynase, který o nasazení vojáků Kaunase požádal, jde o preventivní opatření. Situace na hranicích je v současnosti podle něj klidná.
Katelynas doplnil, že jeho žádost souvisí s incidentem v Lotyšsku, kde se skupina maskovaných ozbrojenců pokusila nelegálně převézt přes hranice skupinku asi 20 migrantů. Podle lotyšské stanice LSM se vojákům…

titulek: Residential buildings on fire in Kyiv after Russian attack, two injured taken to hospital
titulekPuvodni: Residential buildings on fire in Kyiv after Russian attack, two injured taken to hospital
shrnuti: Two residential buildings have caught fire in Kyiv's Solomianskyi district and two injured people have been taken to hospital following a Russian attack on 7 October.

vyrez.text:
Russian attack on Kyiv: fires break out in residential buildings, two people taken to hospital | Ukrainska Pravda
Stock photo: Getty Images
Two residential buildings have caught fire in the Solomianskyi district of Kyiv and two injured people have been taken to hospital as a result of a Russian attack on 7 October, with falling debris also recorded in the Dniprovskyi and Sviatoshynskyi districts.
Source: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko
Quote from Klitschko: "There are two casualties in the Solomianskyi district. Medics have taken both of the injured to hospital."
Advertisement:





Details: In the Solomianskyi district, falling debris caused a fire in a five-storey residential building. According to Klitschko, the fire engulfed the ground to second floors. Rescue workers and medics are working at the scene.
A house also caught fire in the same district as a result of the attack.
In the Dniprovskyi district, debris fell near an educational institution. Early reports indicate that there is no fire.
In the Sviatoshynskyi district, debris fell onto the roof of an administrative building. The roof was partially destroyed, with no fire reported.
Background: Overnight on 7 October,…

vyrizeni.poznamka: Denní ruský útok na Ukrajině bez doloženého následku pro sledované země; běžný typ zprávy, mimo rozsah projektu.
